title: I gave our research tool The Trade Desk’s filings. Could it actually tell whether TTD was losing market share?
author: thinq-81
selftext:
The filings in our example showed slowing growth and margin deterioration. That supports concern about the business. To establish share loss, I’d also want comparable ad-market growth, competitor performance, or evidence that customers moved spend. The company’s own income statement doesn’t settle it.

I’m the founder of Market Ontology. Try the same test in Analyst: “Build the case that TTD lost share. Separate what its filings prove from what would require customer or competitor data.” See where the evidence runs out. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

comments.author: thinq-81
comments.body: My next question would be “What finding would make you abandon the share-loss explanation?” If the answer is another restatement of declining growth, it hasn’t identified a real test. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
